facts.statement: A group of hooligans has moved into the nearby canyon and keeps causing trouble at the farm; wolves also get into the sheep pen.
facts.quote: A group of hooligans has moved into the nearby canyon and are always causing trouble.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (Explore Farnum Farmstead)
article_summaries.summary: An SOE freerealms.com 'What is New?' post (captured 2009-11-23, posted about 4 days earlier) describing Farnum Farmstead, a large private farm south of Crossroads. It covers the sheep (kept by Bo), harvestable crops reachable through a harvesting minigame, the hooligans and wolves causing trouble, and how to get there. The article's heading misspells the name as 'Farmun'; the body and client text use 'Farnum'.
